name: card-db-mvp
description: Phase 1 MVP: public, SEO-first trading-card price database with variant-aware catalog, price history, sold comps, and faceted search. Seeded from the Pokemon TCG API and Scryfall. SQLite for the demo; Postgres + object-storage bucket for production.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:schema: docker compose exec -T db psql -U cardindex -d cardindex -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /db/schema.postgres.sql
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U cardindex -d cardindex
